spec.headline: Static Balance vs. Continuous Solvency
spec.subhead: Autonomous leverage requires continuous risk infrastructure to prevent liquidation across high-frequency market regimes before positions breach solvency thresholds.

blocks.text:
**Static Wallet Balance**

Fixed ledger tracking with zero automated solvency calculation. Remains blind to real-time price volatility and emergent debt exposure.

**Continuous Solvency**

Dynamic health factor derived on demand from collateral against debt. Powers programmatic risk controls and liquidation safeguards.
Deterministic risk computation is essential for autonomous agent credit rails.

focal.reason: Focuses visual hierarchy on continuous solvency over passive balances.

defects.issue: Unparsed markdown syntax rendered as literal text
defects.reason: The strings '**Static Wallet Balance**' and '**Continuous Solvency**' contain raw markdown asterisks, failing to format as bold titles and running directly into the description text.
defects.fix: Strip the asterisks, convert each column title into a distinct block heading with 12px margin-bottom, and render them with primary typographic weight.

defects.issue: Top-heavy composition with dead negative space at bottom
defects.reason: All layout elements are compressed into the upper two-thirds of the canvas, leaving an unanchored, dead void of over 250px below the closing sentence.
defects.fix: Increase spacing between the deck copy and comparison block by 32px, increase column vertical padding, and shift the closing sentence down by 80px to balance the canvas.

defects.issue: Insufficient contrast on secondary comparison column
defects.reason: The muted body copy is dimmed excessively against the dark background, dropping below accessible contrast thresholds and impairing readability.
defects.fix: Increase the text brightness of the left column body copy to at least #9A9AA6 (approx. 60% white) to ensure legibility while retaining hierarchy.
